title: IT Service Analyst II
description:
Withum is a place where talent thrives \- where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results. Withum empowers clients and our professional staff with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management and operational needs. As a US nationally ranked Top 25 firm, we recruit only the best and brightest people with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 Under the overall supervision of the Senior IT Services Manager, the IT Service Analyst II provides first and second level hardware, software, and occasional networking support. Supported by IT team members and management in other Withum offices, this individual is accountable for providing outstanding customer service and technical support to Team Members throughout the Firm and their local office.
 



  





 Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, easy to work with a sense of purpose and caring for their co\-workers and whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





**How You'll Spend Your Time:** 



* Daily monitor the incident management system (ITSM) to ensure tickets are distributed and addressed in a timely manner.
* Timely acknowledgement of support requests
* Document, track, and resolve issues within published service level agreements.
* Document and track hardware distribution via firm asset management software (ITAM)
* Effectively communicate support efforts and resolutions
* Provide 2nd and 3rd level hardware, software, and fundamental networking support.
* Deliver remote support to users throughout the Firm via phone, email, chat or our remote support platform.
* Act as an onsite representative for technology initiatives.
* Assist management in proactively meeting the technology needs of the office by keeping IT management abreast of issues and activities.
* Work closely with members of the IT team to ensure successful completion of technology projects throughout the Firm.
* Seek and create opportunities of growth through automation, innovation and process improvement.
* Other responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
* Completing all required CPE learning hours and yearly goals effectively and timely



  





**Requirements:** 



* Minimum 3 years working experience in related support service field.
* Strong working knowledge of accounting applications, such as CCH Engagement, Thomson GoSystem Tax, XCM, TaxCaddy and SurePrep (desired)
* Experience supporting end\-users in a Microsoft environment.
* Strong working knowledge of but not limited to – Microsoft Products including Teams, Microsoft 365, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Outlook
* Associates degree in an IT related field or combination of education and technical training required
* Windows 10/11, CompTIA A\+, or CompTIA Network\+ or Microsoft Azure certification
* Experience troubleshooting computer and mobile device hardware
* Foundational knowledge in video conferencing and audio\-visual hardware
* Understanding of networking fundamentals
* Understanding of Basic ITIL Process, SLA, Priority \& Severity Matrix
* Self\-motivated and dedicated to continual personal and professional improvement
* Strong verbal and written communication skills are imperative for documentation and the translation of technical subjects to non\-technical staff
* Flexibility to adapt quickly to change within the Firm and within the accounting industry
* Must be able to work extended hours when required
* Ability to lift up to 50lbs
* Experience working in a public accounting, or other professional services, firm a plus
* Willingness to travel to remote offices as needed



  





 Website: www.withum.com
 



  





***Withum will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or because he or she is a protected veteran.***

title: Information Technology Administrator
description:

 *“What’s Your Next.”***




  





**Cavitak**

**Role: IT Administrator** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for an
 **IT Support / IT Administrator** 
 with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in providing day\-to\-day IT support to users and maintaining IT systems and devices.
 



 The role will primarily involve troubleshooting
 **hardware, software, operating system, network, and user\-access issues** 
 , along with supporting the organization's IT infrastructure and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day IT operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide day\-to\-day technical support to employees for hardware, software, and system\-related issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues with
 **desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and other IT devices** 
 .
* Format systems, install and configure Windows OS, applications, drivers, and required software.
* Diagnose and resolve basic hardware issues and coordinate repairs/replacements when required.
* Set up and configure laptops, desktops, email accounts, and other IT equipment for new employees.
* Manage user accounts, passwords, system access, and basic Microsoft 365 administration.
* Troubleshoot basic
 **LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and network connectivity** 
 issues.
* Support Active Directory and basic Windows Server administration.
* Maintain IT assets, inventory, documentation, and records of issued devices.
* Perform system updates, software installations, backups, and basic security checks.
* Coordinate with vendors/service providers for hardware, networking, and other IT\-related issues.
* Ensure IT issues are tracked and resolved within the required timelines.



  





**Preferred Profile** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* **2–3 years of hands\-on experience in IT Support / Desktop Support / System Administration.**
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **Windows OS, hardware troubleshooting, system formatting, software installation, and device configuration** 
 .
* Basic knowledge of
 **Microsoft 365, Active Directory, networking, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs** 
 .
* Experience supporting laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, and other office IT equipment.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills and a user\-focused approach.
* Ability to independently diagnose common IT issues and take ownership until resolution.
* **The ideal candidate should be hands\-on and comfortable troubleshooting and resolving day\-to\-day IT issues rather than being limited to administrative or monitoring activities.**

**Integration \& Technology Support** 



* Coordinate integrations between Yardi and third\-party applications.

**Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:

 The Data Center Engineer is responsible for the management, maintenance, and deployment of the physical infrastructure within the data center. This role involves both building and operational support activities to ensure optimal data center performance and reliability.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 The roles and responsibilities of the build and support Engineer are:

* Work on tickets assigned to fix incidents in the data center on\-site visit is required
* Timely updates with accurate work logs to be updated in ticketing tool.
* Meet all agreed SLA’s with the Customer.
* Immediately escalate to the central project team any abnormal situation in the data center concerning Ericsson equipment at site.
* Asset Management onsite at the data center and reporting
* Site audit conducted as per the official guidelines
* Site spare inventory management and reporting
* Remote support to the onsite engineer to solve the issue
* Support other projects within META program.

* Installation and commissioning of compute and network racks.
* Fibre and copper cable laying, termination, labelling, and dressing.
* Installation and configuration support for network and compute devices.
* Material receipt, verification, and inventory management.
* Performing troubleshooting for hardware, link, and connectivity issues.
* Engaging with customers, vendors, and internal teams for issue resolution.

* Proven experience in remote troubleshooting and ability to operate effectively in a service desk or data centre environment.
* Willingness to work during non\-business hours or in shifts as required by operational needs.
* Strong technical expertise in data center operations and IT infrastructure, including servers, switches, routers, cabling systems, and fibre optics.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain physical infrastructure within a data center environment.
* Flexible and adaptable, capable of working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Skilled in reviewing, enhancing, and maintaining Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and operational guidelines.
* Strong focus on service excellence with a customer\-first mindset, leveraging multi\-domain technical competence.
* Adheres strictly to approved MOPs, safety protocols, and operational instructions without deviation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across teams and with customers.
* A proactive team player with strong interpersonal skills, able to work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams.
* Capable of handling multiple priorities and engaging with both customers and internal stakeholders under high\-pressure situations.
* Proficient in spoken and written English to support effective communication in global environments.

title: Implementation, Training & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Support \& Implementation Specialist** 




**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad (Gujarat)
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time (On\-site)
 



**Shift time:** 
 US Shift (5:30 PM to 3:00 AM)
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




**We seek a highly skilled and motivated EHR/RCM specialist** 
 to join our team. The ideal candidate will primarily be responsible for delivering comprehensive training on EHR (Electronic Health Records) and medical billing processes. Additionally, they will provide implementation training support as needed. This role requires excellent communication skills, adaptability, and willingness to work night shifts.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Training Delivery** 

 :
 



* Conduct detailed and engaging training sessions on EHR systems and medical billing workflows for new hires and existing employees.
* Customize training programs based on the needs of different teams, ensuring all participants gain a clear understanding of processes and tools.



**2\. Implementation Support** 

 :
 



* Assist with the implementation and integration of EHR systems for new clients.
* Provide on\-site or remote support during onboarding, ensuring smooth transitions and user adoption.



**3\. Content Development** 

 :
 



* Created and updated training materials, including manuals, presentations, videos, and other resources, aligned with the latest system updates and industry standards.



**4\. Performance Monitoring** 

 :
 



* Assess trainee performance through tests, feedback sessions, and on\-the\-job evaluations to identify areas for improvement.
* Provide additional support to ensure team members are proficient in using EHR and billing systems.



**5\. Stakeholder Collaboration** 

 :
 



* Work closely with IT, billing, and operations teams to address training needs and system improvements.
* Serve as the primary contact for EHR training\-related queries and troubleshooting.



**6\. Compliance and Standards** 

 :
 



* Ensure that all training adheres to HIPAA regulations and healthcare industry standards.
* Keep abreast of changes in medical billing rules and EHR functionalities to update training modules accordingly.



**7\. Reporting and Documentation** 

 :
 



* Maintain accurate records of training sessions, participant attendance, and outcomes.
* Prepare reports on training effectiveness and suggest improvements to management.



  
 



**Qualifications:** 



* **Experience** 

 : Prior experience in EHR training, medical billing, or a similar role is preferred but not required.
* **Communication Skills** 

 : Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts effectively.
* **Technical Proficiency** 

 : Familiarity with EHR systems, medical billing software, and coding standards (CPT, ICD\-10\).
* **Adaptability** 

 : Willingness to work on a night shift to align with client requirements and team schedules.
* **Interpersonal Skills** 

 : Strong ability to engage with diverse audiences and foster a positive learning environment.



  
 



**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Certification in medical billing or coding is a plus.
* Experience in US healthcare workflows and EHR systems.



  





**Benefits** 
 :\-
 


* Friendly Environment
* Excellent Salary
* 5 Days Working
* Medical \+ Accidental Insurance
* On\-site Yoga, Gym, Sports, and Bhagwat Geeta Session
* Excellent Work\-life balance
* Annual one\-day Trip
* All festival celebrations

title: Implementation Trainer - EHR/RCM
description:
**Company Description** 
 OmniMD is an AI\-driven digital health company with over two decades of experience transforming traditional care models into intelligent, cloud\-based platforms. The organization delivers integrated solutions that support secure, interoperable exchange of health information across systems and providers. With a portfolio of more than 25 products, including EHR, Practice Management, AI Front Desk, AI Medical Scribe, AI RCM, and Chronic Care Management tools, OmniMD serves over 20 medical specialties. Its solutions enhance patient engagement, improve financial outcomes, and streamline workflows through automation, telehealth, remote monitoring, and patient\-facing digital tools. OmniMD fosters an inclusive, innovation\-focused culture built on collaboration, expertise, and continuous improvement in healthcare delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Implementation Trainer – EHR/RCM is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for training healthcare clients and their teams on OmniMD’s EHR and Revenue Cycle Management solutions, including system workflows, best practices, and product features. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting individual and group training sessions, creating training materials and documentation, and supporting clients during implementation, go\-live, and post\-implementation phases. The Implementation Trainer collaborates closely with implementation specialists, product teams, and client stakeholders to gather feedback, troubleshoot user challenges, and refine training approaches. * Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams (implementation, product, support) and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Prior experience in healthcare technology, medical billing, or clinical operations is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, IT, business, or a related field preferred; relevant professional certifications in healthcare IT or training are a plus.
* Willingness to work onsite in Ahmedabad and, when required, travel to client locations for training and implementation

title: Senior cloud operations engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer\-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world. Compute is one of the core organisations within OCI. We are responsible for providing Compute power i.e. VMs and BMs. Cloud pretty much cannot exists without our org. The Compute org comprises of a family of critical foundational infrastructure services that drive OCI's hardware lifecycle activities
   

  

 Work with product team on the shared full stack ownership of a collection of services and/or technology areas. Understand the end\-to\-end configuration, technical dependencies, and overall behavioural characteristics of production services. Responsible for the mitigating critical customer incidents, or deployments or testing required to improve security, performance, availability, and scalability of service. Authority for end\-to\-end performance and operability. Partner with development teams in meeting SLA to unblock customers. Articulate technical characteristics of services and technology areas and guide Development Teams to engineer and add premier capabilities to the Oracle Cloud service portfolio. Understand and communicate the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of the service and technology stack. Demonstrate clear understanding of automation and orchestration principles. Act as ultimate escalation point for complex or critical issues that have not yet been documented as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Utilise a deep understanding of service topology and their dependencies required to troubleshoot issues and define mitigations. Understand and explain the effect of product architecture decisions on distributed systems. Professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies.
   

  

 Responsible for the operation of production environments, including systems and databases, supporting critical business operations. Will perform administration and analysis for multiple production environments and recommend new and novel solutions to improve availability, performance, and supportability. This is an opportunity to bring a combination of deep technical knowledge with administration/analysis knowledge of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure to provide escalation support to a wide range of complex production environment problems related to immense growth, scaling, leveraging the cloud, extremely high performance, and high availability requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize all production server hardware and software. Provide escalated technical support for complex technical issues which may include leading problem management cases and providing management status. Coordinate escalated support cases and lead appropriate internal technical resources and/or third party vendors to resolution and coordinate a storage infrastructure of Oracle system and database appliances. Responsible for Oracle production environments; assist with server operating system and application upgrades, bug fixes, and patching; and work on standardization projects for both hardware and software under the Oracle technology stack while providing consistent system uptime as expected in a Cloud environment. Provide on\-call support, on a rotating basis. Responsibilities include but not limited to
   

  

 Incident Management
   

  

 Support and troubleshooting of Staging/Production environments
   

  

 Response and Resolve incidents as per SLA's
   

  

 Organise, Anticipate, Plan and work as On\-Call in shifts for multiple services (Open to work in shifts \& shows flexibility)
   

  

 Maintain Service High Availability
   

  

 Release Management
   

  

 Test and Deploy solutions and automate to replace manual processes
   

  

 Build and maintain deployment tools/procedures
   

  

 Zero downtime deployments and a high availability mindset
   

  

 Define and build innovative solution methodologies and assets around infrastructure, cloud migration and deployment operations at scale.
   

  

 Work with service teams to resolve complex issues that require troubleshooting and knowledge of code.
   

  

 Keep documentation up to date and resolving similar tickets with lower turnaround time and within SLA
   

  

 Ensure production security posture
   

  

 Ensure monitoring is robust and effective
   

  

 Change Management
   

  

 Perform Root Cause Analysis
   

  

 Required Skills:
   

  

 5\+ years overall experience in IT industry
   

  

**Minimum 4 Years Of Experience As a Sys Admin/Support**
 Strong systems architecture skills
   

  

 Strong Linux administration (Understanding of different Hardware family)
   

  

 Virtualisation Technologies
   

  

 Scripting Language (Python/Bash/Shell etc, basic understanding of Java / Go will be good to have)
   

  

 Understanding of Networking, Cloud Computing, Load Balancers
   

  

 Hands on experience at Monitoring/Instrumentation tools (Prometheus/Grafana, new relic, elastic or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience with maintaining high scale deployments, managing high throughput and IO intensive services.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of system configuration tools such as Chef, Terraform, GIT, Jenkins/Hudson, Artifactory
   

  

 Continuous Integration development/deployment, e.g. Docker, Kubernetes
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
**Hiring 1st Line Service Desk Analyst for Cloud based IT Firm with 3\-5 years of experience (UK Shift)** 




  





**Salary Budget upto 7 LPA. English communication mandatory.** 




  





**Description:** 




 Role purpose Provide a responsive, customer\-focused first point of contact for colleagues across the business. The role logs, owns, diagnoses and resolves common IT incidents and service requests at first contact wherever possible, escalating effectively while keeping users informed and maintaining accurate ticket records.
 



  





**Key responsibilities End user support** 



* Provide telephone and remote support to pharmacy, support\-office and other business colleagues.
* Communicate clearly with users who may be working in time\-critical operational environments.
* Take ownership from initial contact through resolution or effective escalation, providing regular updates.



  





**Incident and request handling** 



* Log, categorize, prioritize and update incidents and requests accurately within the ITSM tool (ServiceDesk Plus).
* Complete structured first\-line diagnosis, capture relevant evidence and resolve using approved knowledge and runbooks.
* Escalate to 2nd line, application teams, field support or third\-party suppliers with complete diagnostic information.
* Monitor assigned tickets, chase progress and confirm service restoration with the user before closure.



  





**Technical support** 



* Support user accounts, passwords, Microsoft 365, Windows devices, printers, scanners and common connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot pharmacy hardware, software, network access and peripheral issues within documented scope.
* Support joiner, mover and leaver requests, software access and standard device setup in line with approvals.



  





**Service management and quality** 



* Work to agreed service levels and follow Incident, Request, Major Incident and escalation processes.
* Maintain clear, factual and auditable ticket notes, including actions taken, evidence, user updates and resolution details.
* Use and improve knowledge articles, known\-error guidance and standard operating procedures.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute evidence to Problem Management and continual service improvement.
* Follow information\-security, data\-protection, access\-control and change\-management requirements.
* Work collaboratively across the Service Desk and wider IT teams, sharing knowledge and supporting shift coverage.



  





**Essential skills and experience** 



* Experience in a customer service, technical support or Service Desk environment
* Experience answering queries by telephone and by email
* Good working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, user accounts, desktop hardware, printers and basic networking.
* A logical troubleshooting approach with the ability to ask effective questions and follow documented processes.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong ownership and the ability to prioritise competing demands.
* Accurate ticket documentation and awareness of ITIL\-aligned service management principles.



  





**Desirable skills and experience** 



* Previous experience supporting community pharmacies or other high\-volume retail locations.
* Experience supporting Apotec, FLOWRx and ProScript Connect pharmacy systems.
* Knowledge of pharmacy peripherals, dispensing workflows, scanners, label printers and third\-party supplier escalation.
* ITIL Foundation, Microsoft fundamentals or an equivalent service desk qualification.



  





**(Working Hours/Timing: 1:30 pm to 10:30 pm 6 months and 2:30 pm to 11:30 pm 6 months due to daylight UK timing)** 




  





**Interested candidate can send their resume on varsha@postaresume.co.in** 




**Call now on \+91\- 6354797016**
